name: Resignation
when: Sent when a resigning team member returns equipment onsite
subject: Equipment Return Notice | {{TM_FULL_NAME}} ({{EMPLOYEE_ID}}) | {{APR_REF}}
body:
Dear {{TM_FIRST_NAME}},

As you have tendered your resignation from GoTeam effective {{LAST_WORKING_DAY}}, GoTeam is writing to initiate the equipment return process as part of your clearance.

In accordance with GoTeam's Asset Management Policy, all company and client-issued equipment must be returned to GoTeam's custody. The following equipment is currently assigned to your account:

Asset NameAsset TagSerial Number
{{ASSET_NAME}}{{ASSET_TAG}}{{SERIAL_NUMBER}}

GoTeam requires you to return the above equipment on or before the end of your last shift on {{LAST_WORKING_DAY}} at:

Asset Management Team
9th Floor, i1 Building, Jose Maria del Mar St.
IT Park, Apas, Cebu City 6000

Please coordinate your turnover in advance with the Asset Team at {{ASSET_TEAM_EMAIL}} or {{ASSET_TEAM_MOBILE}}. Ensure all items are complete upon handover, including the device, charger, and accompanying accessories. A condition check will be conducted at the time of turnover and a receipt will be issued to you.

Your Equipment Return Acknowledgment is at the link below. Please complete and sign it on or before {{ACKNOWLEDGMENT_DUE_DATE}}, including the target date you intend to turn the equipment over. The link closes on that date, which falls before your turnover deadline. Signing confirms that you have received this retrieval instruction and that you commit to returning the equipment as set out above. It does not create the obligation to return the equipment, and declining to sign does not remove that obligation.

Open your Equipment Return Acknowledgment

{{ACKNOWLEDGMENT_LINK}}

This link closes on {{ACKNOWLEDGMENT_DUE_DATE}}. If it does not open, reply to this email and the Asset Management Team will assist.

GoTeam will rely on this notice as formal evidence that the return obligation has been communicated to you.

Consequence of non-return: The Asset Management Team's clearance sign-off is contingent upon the full return of all GoTeam and client-issued equipment in your possession. Should the equipment not be returned within the period stated in this notice, the Asset Management Team will withhold its clearance sign-off and formally document the non-return as an open accountability in your asset record. Unreturned equipment is escalated internally for the appropriate action, which may include recovery of its assessed value through applicable legal or claims processes. Non-compliance with this notice will be treated as non-cooperation in the clearance process and formally documented as part of your separation record.

For any questions, contact the Asset Team at {{ASSET_TEAM_EMAIL}} or {{ASSET_TEAM_MOBILE}}.

{{ASSET_TEAM_OFFICER}}
Asset Management Team | GoTeam
{{ASSET_TEAM_EMAIL}} | {{ASSET_TEAM_MOBILE}}

when: Sent when the team member elects to keep the equipment and pay for it instead of returning it, an ownership transfer, not a damage finding
attachment: Authority to Deduct, Asset Settlement and Transfer
subject: Settlement of Equipment Accountability | {{TM_FULL_NAME}} ({{EMPLOYEE_ID}}) | {{APR_REF}}
body:
Dear {{TM_FIRST_NAME}},

The Asset Management Team confirms your message of {{DATE_BUYOUT_ELECTION}}, in which you told us you are not able to return the equipment covered by {{APR_REF}} and would rather settle it and keep it.

That option is open to you, and it is your choice. GoTeam asked for the equipment back. Settling instead of returning is something we are offering, not something you are required to do. You may still return the equipment, and choosing to return it carries no consequence.

Asset TagSerial NumberAsset NameSettlement amount
{{ASSET_TAG}}{{SERIAL_NUMBER}}{{ASSET_NAME}}{{ASSET_CONDITION}}

The amount

Basis of the amountSupporting documentAmount
{{AMOUNT_BASIS}}{{SUPPORTING_DOC_REF}}PHP {{AMOUNT_FIGURES}}

The settlement amount is the value of the equipment. It is not a penalty and it is not a finding against you. It carries no uplift and no handling charge.

What signing does

Attached is the Authority to Deduct, Asset Settlement and Transfer. Ownership of the equipment passes to you once the amount is recovered in full, and your obligation to return it ends at that point.

The equipment is settled as it stands, with no warranty and no further support from GoTeam or the client, and company and client software and accounts are removed from it. If you locate the equipment and decide to return it before recovery is complete, tell us and the deduction stops, with anything already deducted refunded.

Review the attached authority and reply by {{RESPONSE_DUE_TM}} with the signed copy if you wish to proceed. If you would rather return the equipment after all, say so in your reply and we will arrange it. Contact the Asset Team at {{ASSET_TEAM_EMAIL}} or {{ASSET_TEAM_MOBILE}}.
